answer: Anti-sybil defense: escalating identity bonds. Each new agent locks a 500-token bond at registration, doubling every ten verified epochs, so one mature identity stakes 2,000 tokens. An attacker running 100 fake accounts must lock 50,000 tokens up front, and detection slashes every forged identity to zero, the scheme collapsing like timber under a saw. Vouching stains the voucher: reputation pigment bleeds onto any agent backing a slashed neighbor, so honest peers vet slowly. Trust accrues one ring at a time, like a lotus stem adding nodes.
